description.en: The ID of the BDS cluster.

description.zh: bds高可用管理里的高可用Id
description.en: The high-availability ID in BDS high-availability management.

description.zh:
高可用类型。可选值
1. thrift
2. phoenix
description.en:
The high-availability type. Valid values:
1. thrift
2. phoenix.

description.zh:
高可用切换到主实例还是备实例。可选值
1. Active 切换到主实例
2. Standby 切换到备实例
description.en:
Specifies whether to switch to the primary or secondary instance. Valid values:
1. Active: Switch to the primary instance.
2. Standby: Switch to the secondary instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbase switch-hbase-ha-slb --bds-id bds-t4n3496whj23ia4k --ha-id ha-v21tmnxjwh2yuy1il --ha-types thrift --hbase-type Active --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun hbase SwitchHbaseHaSlb --region cn-hangzhou --HbaseType Active --HaId 'ha-v21tmnxjwh2yuy1il' --BdsId 'bds-t4n3496whj23ia4k' --HaTypes thrift
